FADE IN:

EXT. CASTLE - DAY

The camera pans over the rolling hills and lush forests of the medieval kingdom, but something is off. The once-majestic stone walls now seem dull and grey, the flags bearing the royal crest now faded and worn. The king, KING ARTHUR, sits on his throne, surrounded by his advisors.

KING ARTHUR
(to his advisors)
I have a vision, my friends. A vision of a new era for our kingdom. An era of... (he pauses, searching for the right words)...futurism.

ADVISOR 1
(skeptical)
Futurism, Your Majesty?

KING ARTHUR
(nodding)
Yes. We will incorporate the latest trends from the East, the most advanced technologies from the North. We will make our kingdom the envy of all the land.

The advisors exchange worried glances, but King Arthur presses on.

KING ARTHUR
(to his scribe)
Write down the decrees. We will establish a new department of... (he consults a parchment)...Vaporwave Affairs.

CUT TO:

INT. CASTLE - DAY

The scribe scribbles furiously as King Arthur explains his vision to the court.

KING ARTHUR
We will import the finest fabrics from the Orient, the most exquisite silks and velvets. We will adorn our halls with... (he gestures to a nearby tapestry)...these strange, glowing patterns.

The courtiers look on in confusion as the scribe writes down the decrees.

CUT TO:

EXT. CASTLE - DAY

The kingdom's artisans set to work, transforming the castle's architecture into a surreal, dreamlike landscape. Walls are covered in glowing, neon-colored murals, while the flags bearing the royal crest are replaced with ones bearing strange, abstract symbols.

CUT TO:

INT. CASTLE - DAY

King Arthur sits on his throne, surrounded by his advisors and courtiers. The room is filled with the soft hum of machinery and the glow of holographic projections.

KING ARTHUR
(to his advisors)
We will make our kingdom the center of the... (he consults a parchment)...Vaporwave Empire.

The advisors look on in confusion, but King Arthur presses on.

KING ARTHUR
(to the courtiers)
We will establish a new currency, one based on... (he gestures to a nearby chest)...these strange, glowing tokens.

The courtiers look on in amazement as the king's advisors and courtiers begin to murmur among themselves.

CUT TO:

EXT. CASTLE - DAY

The kingdom's subjects begin to notice the changes. They see the glowing murals, the strange, abstract symbols on the flags, and the soft hum of machinery. They look on in confusion, unsure what to make of the new, surreal landscape.

KING ARTHUR

FADE TO BLACK.

THE END.
